data.body: RCA boundary note from Gerrit 1827 run 31961655783: this omitted-basetemp sibling is independently valid but did not cause the authorship batched-map failure. The CI parent explicitly ran with --basetemp=/home/runner/work/_temp/rebar-basetemp, and the failing active tracker lived under that tree. _collect_node_ids launches nested pytest without --basetemp, so its cleanup is confined to pytest's separate default /tmp/pytest-of-runner numbered root; it cannot delete or traverse the active authorship tmp_path. Returning this ticket to open for its own planned repair; no code or tests were changed here.
